Q: Decorators terminology A:

You're correct that "wrapped function" can be ambiguous, but it will usually be clear from context which one you actually mean. Usually I think it will be understood to be the original function.

You can also just say "original function".

The "wrapper function" will usually be understood to mean the function in the decorator that wraps around the original function.

So in your example, def measure_time defines the decorator, and def wrapper defines the wrapper function. "Wrapped function" can refer to either def do_work or the call to do_work() in main(); in the former case it means the original function that will be wrapped by the decorator, in the latter case it means the resulting function that includes the wrapper added by the decorator.

Q: How to deal with concurrency failure on IdentityUser update? A:

I got this error while trying to rename a role using RoleManager.UpdateAsync() with an MVC form in ASP.NET Core. To make sure the right role record is being updated when the IdentityRole model is posted back from the view, the ID property is placed inside a <input type="hidden"> element. The same must be done with the ConcurrencyStamp property to avoid the concurrency error.

Replace $n with below variable,You will get prompt box to enter number of VMs you want to create, $vms variable will store numbers VMs you wanted to create.

[int]$vms = [Microsoft.VisualBasic.Interaction]::InputBox("Enter number of VMs you want to create", "VMs")

Q: The connection manager will not acquire a connection because the connection manager OfflineMode property is TRUE A:

I believe this error is happening because TNS entry is mission in that machine.

Please verify if oracle TNS for the database is present in that machine or not?

You can find the TNS file in the below path.

C:\Oracle\product\11.2.0\client_1\network\admin

If it is not there and try one more time.
